Original authors and contributors retain their rights. This is an independently
modified application, not an official upstream release. Changes through 2026-11-05
include automation, screen sharing, optional enhanced input, HTTP/MQTT, vision
provider configuration, enrollment, camera observation, goal loops, voice drafts,
controller/home layouts, colored keyboards and device management.
